description: The full syntax of Lore, the Lorem artifact language, generated from the layout and per-kind schemas so it is never out of date. Defaults to the deck grammar; pass kind:"flyer", kind:"page", kind:"tshirt", kind:"brochure", kind:"video" or kind:"storefront" for that kind's frontmatter, container blocks and layouts. Read this once before writing anything non-trivial.
